title: Igadi Eyanyamalala Ngobusuku Obodwa
intro: Khawucinge ngegadi entle, ezele ziziqhamo ezivuthiweyo kwaye ijikelezwe yimithi emide. Abo babeyinyamekela babecinga ukuba bakrelekrele, beceba isivuno sabo kwiiyure ezizolileyo ngaphambi kokusa, kude namehlo abo basweleyo. Kodwa Lowo ungalaliyo wayenezinye izicwangciso zentsikelelo yakhe efihliweyo. Ungaqikelela ukuba ngubani omi ngasemva kweli bali lesilumkiso elivela kwiQuran?
clues: Sakha sanegadi echumileyo neninzi kangangokuba yaba ngumona kubo bonke abadlulayo.
Ekucwangciseni kwethu, sahlebelana kwakusasa, sivakalisa ukuba akukho mntu usweleyo oya kuvunyelwa ukuba angene ngaloo mini.
Sasingabantu abazizityebi, kwaye iintliziyo zethu zazingaboni amalungelo amahlwempu asingqongileyo.
Xa kwafika ukusa kwesivuno esasisifuna ukusenza, sasondela emyezweni wethu saza sawufumana uguqulwe waba yinkangala emnyama ngobusuku obunye.
Umyalelo otshabalalisayo wadlula, ungashiyi nto ngaphandle kothuthu apho kwakuxhonywe khona iziqwenga zeziqhamo ezivuthiweyo.
Ibali lethu lisilumkiso esiqatha esibhalwe kwiQuran, apho saziwa njengabanini begadi ababengavumeli uncedo kubantu abasweleyo.
